invalidCode: That code didn’t work. Check the latest email, or send a new code.
invalidEmail: That doesn’t look like an email address.

field.displayNameInvalid: That name has characters we can’t show.
field.emailInvalid: That doesn’t look like an email address.

emailTaken: That email already has a CityTurfer account. Try another one.
emailCodeInvalid: That code didn’t work. Check the latest email to {email}, or start again.
passwordBreached: That password appears in leaked password lists, so it’s easy to guess. Choose another one.
accountOffline: No connection. Changes to your account need the internet; nothing was changed.
signInOffline: No connection. Signing in needs the internet once; after that the app works offline.
rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
rateLimitedSeconds: Too many tries. Wait {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} and try again.
rateLimitedMinutes: Too many tries. Wait {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and try again.
rateLimitedHours: Too many tries. Wait {count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} and try again.
signedOut: This phone isn’t signed in to your account any more. Sign out, then sign in with your email.
server: Our server had a hiccup. Try again in a moment.
accountsUnavailable: Signing in to an account is not available in this build.
wrongChosenPassword: Wrong email or password. No account password yet? Sign in with an email code, then set one in Me › Account.
tookLongPassword: That took a while. Sign in again.
tookLongCode: That took a while. Send a new code and sign in again.
linkedToAccount: This phone’s history now belongs to your CityTurfer account. Sign in with that account’s email.

backup.no-token: Sign in with your email to back up.
backup.auth: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to carry on backing up.
backup.consent: The server has no backup consent from you yet. Turn backup off and on again.
backup.offline: No connection right now. We'll carry on when you're online.
backup.server: The server had a hiccup. We'll try again shortly.
backup.not-ready: The backup server isn't ready yet. Your activities wait safely on this phone.
backup.busy: The server is busy. We'll try again in a moment.
backup.outdated: Update CityTurfer to keep backing up.
backup.not-available: Cloud backup isn’t available in this build: everything stays on this phone.
backup.needs-device-token: A testing server needs a device token. Add one in Developer tools, or go back to the built-in server.

backupOffPending: Backup is off. We'll let the server know next time you're online.
backupOffNeedsCode: Backup is off, but the server still has your copy. To have it deleted, confirm your email with a code.
backupWaitingForRestore: Restoring your backup first. Backing up carries on once it has finished.

backupAction.invalid-token: That doesn't look like a device token. Paste it again.
backupAction.invalid-server-url: Use a full address starting with https:// (or http:// on your own network).
backupAction.withdrawal-pending: The server hasn't deleted your backup copy yet. Try again once you're online.

backupLink.offline: No connection. Sending and checking the code needs the internet; nothing was changed.
backupLink.notLocalProfile: This profile can’t be backed up from here. Sign out, then sign in with your email to back up.
backupLink.notSignedIn: This profile isn’t open on this phone any more. Go back to Info and try again.
backupLink.emailMismatch: That code is for another address. Use the latest code we sent to {email}.
backupLink.profileTaken: This profile’s history now belongs to another CityTurfer account. Sign in with that account’s email to back it up.
backupLink.linkedElsewhere: The account for {email} already keeps its history in another profile on this phone. To back that profile up, sign out, then sign in with an email code to {email}.
